message: Astra: Within Fa na’s investigation, which sentence supports your claim that “the consequences are severe,” and what can a reader actually infer from it? What deserves attention: the consequence itself or how the draft communicates it? What could further thinking resolve that a revision would not, and what uncertainty would make an attempt premature? What evidence would justify your choice? Could you briefly name your finding, uncertainty, and next intention in English, then carry out your chosen step?
